title_zh: v195.2 固定对角 signed-sketch 修正在完整 p22 开发轨迹上失败
title_en: v195.2 frozen diagonal signed-sketch correction fails on the complete p22 development trajectory
scientific_question: Does the separately frozen one-step diagonal signed-sketch correction remain strictly safe across every frame and calibration of the already-opened complete p22 development trajectory under both five-camera and all-nine-camera sensing?

frozen_mechanisms.primary: the v194 diagonal signed-sketch formula, applied once before one unchanged physical CGLS K1 step
frozen_mechanisms.fit_mean_control: fit-only mean coordinate followed by the same unchanged physical CGLS K1 step
frozen_mechanisms.signed_seed_control: the frozen signed-sketch seed followed by the same unchanged physical CGLS K1 step
frozen_mechanisms.full_dct_control: the equal-call full-DCT coordinate followed by the same unchanged physical CGLS K1 step
frozen_mechanisms.adaptation: none: no step-size, damping, ridge, clipping, fallback, threshold search, sketch search, learned model, or post-result role change

execution_boundary.earlier_failed_attempts: Two earlier executions stopped before scientific scoring because of contract or validity-implementation errors; their partial artifacts are excluded from the verdict.

interpretation_zh: v194 的逐坐标线索没有跨越到完整轨迹成功。固定对角 primary 在五相机仅 987/1313 个单元严格安全、0/13 个标定组完整通过；九相机为 1234/1313 与 3/13。它在两臂都未达到完整门，因此该固定机制关闭。
interpretation_en: The coordinate-wise clue from v194 does not survive the complete-trajectory gate. The frozen diagonal primary is strict-safe in only 987/1313 cells and 0/13 complete calibration groups under five cameras, and 1234/1313 cells and 3/13 groups under all nine. It misses the complete gate in both arms, closing this frozen mechanism.
decision_boundary_zh: 判决顺序在 primary 失败处停止。full-DCT 同价对照更强，但五相机仍只有 1310/1313、12/13，不能构成两档相机完整成功，也不能事后替换 primary。p14 新鲜验证、资源门、外部门、神经训练和 GPU 均未授权。
decision_boundary_en: Adjudication stops at primary failure. The equal-call full-DCT control is stronger, but its five-camera arm still reaches only 1310/1313 cells and 12/13 complete groups, so it does not establish complete two-sensor success and cannot replace the primary post hoc. Fresh p14 validation, resource gates, external gates, neural training, and GPU use remain unauthorized.
route_action: Close only the fixed one-step diagonal signed-sketch correction on the already-opened complete p22 development trajectory. Do not tune or rename it, do not open p14, and do not treat the stronger full-DCT diagnostic as a successful deployable method. Continue the wider C route only with genuinely new physical information or a separately preregistered representational mechanism.
